title: binderconfirm
summary: The innkeeper confirmation now follows current Benilla's BinderConfirm StaticPopup behavior: exact area-aware prompt and fallback, fully law-owned top popup seat, text, button size/position and stock-art UV geometry, Accept-only CMSG_BINDER_ACTIVATE, cancel/Escape without wire, and the shared 30.864 yd² service-range expiry. The renderer contains no explicit Vector2 geometry construction. The former ad-hoc centered confirmation geometry is gone, and the unrelated custom 420x250 Inn & Hearthstone ImGui window that appeared after item use has also been removed; hearth wire, cooldown and teleport observation remain intact.

openItems.text: Focused packet, text, geometry, source-fence and range checks pass. Needs a live innkeeper acceptance/cancellation/range-exit pass and visual comparison of the StaticPopup shell.
The BinderConfirm renderer still constructed the button size and stock-art UV maximum directly instead of consuming BinderConfirmUiLaw geometry.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: BinderConfirmUiLaw now owns the scaled button size and UV maximum, the renderer has a no-new-Vector2 source fence, and the focused Binder plus full interface clinical suites pass.
